comparisons.template: About 25 African elephants, trunks to tails.
125 small cars, if you stacked them into a cube.
Over 300 concert grand pianos — enough for every seat in a mid-sized orchestra hall.
12 full London buses, minus the passengers.
Nearly 19 T-Rex, which still wouldn't tip the scale.
About 1/48th of the Eiffel Tower's iron frame — the tower is in a league of its own.
A little over a third of the International Space Station, which orbits at 7.7 km per second.
The combined weight of around 107,000 human brains, give or take.
A single grain of rice weighs about 2.5 feathers — rice is denser than it looks.
A hummingbird weighs as much as 300 feathers, and needs every gram to stay airborne.
A standard paperclip equals 100 feathers, which makes paperclips feel surprisingly substantial.
An AA battery weighs 2,300 feathers — batteries really are denser than you'd think.
Your iPhone weighs 17,100 feathers, which is roughly 2.5 bald eagles' worth.
Your own heart is the weight of 30,000 feathers, pumping 24 hours a day.
A kilogram of sugar equals 100,000 feathers — more than 14 full eagles' worth.
You'd need 15 billion feathers to match a single blue whale.
